description: Documented relationships between a company and other entities (officers, domicile, contracts, grants, IP assets, corporate links, mentions), each with source, date, confidence and evidence URL. Filter with `type` and `confidence`. Documentary only: a relationship does not imply control, responsibility or current validity.

confidence.description: Only relationships with this confidence level.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_relationships
